summary.name: Apify
summary.description: A comprehensive cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and process automation, offering 10,000+ serverless Actors for structured data collection at scale.

gaps: Inconsistent file extensions: Many primary platform links (e.g., /store, /actors) do not resolve to explicitly Markdown-friendly endpoints, which can result in verbose HTML ingestion.
Lack of a dedicated 'Quickstart' or 'Getting Started' summary section for developer-centric RAG ingestion.
Some marketing-heavy URLs may provide unnecessary HTML overhead that is not optimized for token-efficient RAG retrieval.
recommendations: Configure the server to support 'Accept: text/markdown' for all URL paths to allow for cleaner content negotiation without needing to append extensions.
Add a dedicated 'Quickstart' section under the summary block to provide immediate code-snippet access for LLM agents.
If server-side content negotiation is not feasible, ensure that key marketing pages provide an alternative URL with a .md suffix to facilitate clean ingestion.
Maintain the existing high-quality documentation links (already utilizing .md) as the primary knowledge source.
